"We had a race condition, here's the fix, here's the process change" is a bad Tuesday. "They buried it" is a pattern.

On "four clean nights proves it was dormant": dormant isn't the same as harmless. Dormant means live and waiting. A race condition that only fires when the upstream is slow is *still* a race condition — it was always going to fire on the first slow night, and slow nights are guaranteed with any vendor. The 504 chose the date; the missing lock chose the damage.

Here's what I'll happily do, though, because there's a lot of room between "confess everything in the headline" and "pin it on the vendor":

- **Don't over-flagellate about the review gap.** It goes in the Jira RCA as a contributing factor; the exec summary just needs "change has been corrected and review controls tightened." One line.
